spec: §5.3 text-order multi-block action and cross-block lifetimes
derivation: First copies p to d and flips t[0]; second applies CX t[0] t[1], XORs d into t and uncopies d. At t=p=0 the result is 3; reversing the semantic gates would give 1. Scratch d spans blocks and is clean on release. Independent enumeration covers all sixteen t,p tuples and the reference binary agrees in both directions.
